caseName: Public Service Commission of Utah v. United States
caseNameFull: Public Service Commission of Utah v. United States
attorneys: E. R. Callister, Attorney General of Utah, Raymond W. Gee, Assistant Attorney General, Calvin L. Ramplón and Keith Sohm for movants-appellants. Elmer B. Collins, Bryan P. Leverich, Ernest P. Porter, Peter W. Billings, Wood R. Worsley and A. U. Miner were on a brief in opposition for the Denver & Rio Grande Western Railroad Co. et al., railroad appellees.

opinions.text:
356 U. S. 421. The motion to allow and tax costs is granted to the extent of nine-elevenths of such costs which are hereby taxed against appellees exclusive of the United States and the Interstate Commerce Commission.

Mr. Justice Stewart took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion.
